description: This file defines the BasicUserRoleManager class, which extends AbstractUserRoleManager and handles user role management, access control, and permissions for the OrangeHRM web application. It includes methods for role initialization, permission checks, entity accessibility, and retrieving user-specific configurations such as default pages and quick launch items.

classes.name: BasicUserRoleManager
classes.description: This class manages user roles, permissions, and access controls within the OrangeHRM system, providing methods for role initialization, permission checks, entity access, and retrieval of configurable UI elements based on user roles.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the BasicUserRoleManager instance and loads predefined user role configurations.

methods.name: _init
methods.description: Loads and maps roles to their specific classes during construction.

methods.name: getUserRoleClass
methods.description: Retrieves the class instance associated with a given role name.

methods.name: getScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: setScreenPermissionService
methods.description: Sets a custom ScreenPermissionService instance.

methods.name: getHomePageDao
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: setHomePageDao
methods.description: Sets a custom HomePageDao instance.

methods.name: getAccessFlowStateMachineService
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the AccessFlowStateMachineService instance.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntities
methods.description: Returns a list of entities accessible to the user for a specific entity type and operation.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityProperties
methods.description: Returns properties of entities that are accessible based on user permissions.

methods.name: getAccessibleEntityIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of entities that the user can access.

methods.name: isActionAllowed
methods.description: Checks if a user can perform a specific action in a given workflow and state.

methods.name: getAllowedActions
methods.description: Retrieves a list of actions permitted for the user in a specific workflow and state.

methods.name: getActionableStates
methods.description: Returns the states where specific actions can be applied.

methods.name: getUniqueActionsBasedOnPriority
methods.description: Merges action items, prioritizing higher priority actions.

methods.name: isEntityAccessible
methods.description: Determines if a specific entity is accessible to the user.

methods.name: areEntitiesAccessible
methods.description: Checks if multiple entities are accessible to the user.

methods.name: getEmployeesWithRole
methods.description: Retrieves employees associated with a specific role.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissions
methods.description: Returns data group permissions for a role and data group name.

methods.name: getDataGroupPermissionCollection
methods.description: Fetches a collection of data group permissions with filtering options.

methods.name: getModuleDefaultPage
methods.description: Gets the default page configured for a specific module.

methods.name: getHomePage
methods.description: Retrieves the user's designated home page based on roles.

methods.name: fixUserRoleNameForWorkflowStateMachine
methods.description: Adjusts role names used in workflow state machine context.

methods.name: getAccessibleQuickLaunchList
methods.description: Provides a list of quick launch items accessible to the user.
